title: smart_port
description: Added automatic currency deposit and output machines, along with configuration files, for Create: Numismatics.
body:
This mod serves the no7 modpack.

It adds the following features:

**1. For Create: Numismatics:**
> - Added a Smart Bank Interface for automatic currency input and output.
> 
> - Added a Smart Bank Terminal that can directly open the bank and displays your current balance when worn in the trinket slot.
> 
> - Fixed an overflow issue that occurred when bank deposits exceeded 2,147,483,647.
> 
> - Added a configuration file to customize currency value, with BigInteger support.
